Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (2)
1. A photo downloads twice during a batch 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>createSaveAll.tap() downloads entries from its original ready snapshot without checking whether
>save(p) handed one over during an inter-download wait. If someone taps a not-yet-downloaded photo
>while a laptop batch is running, the single-photo control downloads it immediately and the batch
>downloads it again when its turn arrives.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R53-54]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/134/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR53-R54) > >```diff >+ if (i) await wait(DOWNLOAD_GAP); >+ try { download(ready[i].file); handed.add(ready[i].pid); } catch (e) { console.warn('download failed', ready[i].file?.name, e); } >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >A single-photo tap can hand over a photo while Save all is waiting between downloads, but the batch still downloads that photo from its earlier snapshot. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/saveall.js[52-55] >- web/index.html[326-328] > >## Recommended Fix >Coordinate the single-photo action with an active batch and recheck the shared handed-over state immediately before each batch download. Add a test that taps a later photo during the inter-download wait and verifies it downloads only once. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/afd7a518-f27e-476e-bc87-44c39d2b0623?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/afd7a518-f27e-476e-bc87-44c39d2b0623)
View medium (1)
2. A verifying photo disappears from counts 🐞 Bug
>
>Description >
> >
>saveBatch() counts a photo as arriving only while its ID remains in incoming, although the
>receiver removes that entry before asynchronous hash verification finishes. If Save all is tapped
>while verification is pending, the photo is neither eligible nor counted as still arriving, so the
>page can say Nothing new to save despite that transfer still being processed.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[web/saveall.js[R16-17]](https://github.com/jtbinith/qodo-hack-2026/pull/134/files#diff-1197fbbadbb14a53258dbd75d68b20c8bf37f2e49062120e60b6b11916a8861fR16-R17) > >```diff >+ let arriving = 0; >+ for (const fid of incoming.keys()) if (!fid.startsWith('thumb:') && !files.has(fid)) arriving++; >``` >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >The receiver removes a completed transfer from `incoming` before verifying its hash, leaving Save all unable to count it as ready or still arriving. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- web/index.html[209-210] >- web/index.html[222-238] >- web/saveall.js[10-18] > >## Recommended Fix >Track full-file transfers awaiting verification separately and include them in Save all's arriving count until verification succeeds or fails. Avoid leaving them in the retryable `incoming` map unless its retry and failure paths are updated too; test a Save all tap while verification is pending. >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >
[Dismiss ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/9b60e05d-5c29-456a-992a-f8bbf48affb2?action=dismiss&origin=git) | [View ↗](https://app.qodo.ai/findings/9b60e05d-5c29-456a-992a-f8bbf48affb2)
